Mission Local reported that the State Bar sent DA Brooke Jenkins to a diversionary program after a two-and-a-half-year process. The story says the complaints were “best resolved” by requiring her to participate, and that the Bar dismissed the other complaints except for the one involving her access to and sharing of a confidential rap sheet.

The story: “DA Brooke Jenkins, in the ultimate irony, is placed in diversionary program,” published April 9, 2025.
